specification_metadata.title: Guardian Alpha V30 Stage 2G-R - Causal Event Handling and Immutability Specification
specification_metadata.purpose: Institutional Causal Streaming and Event-Driven Ingestion Protocol

fifteen_institutional_causal_rules.name: Unique Stable Event Identifiers
fifteen_institutional_causal_rules.specification: Every market event (bar, dividend, split, corporate revision) possesses a globally unique, deterministic identifier: evt_{ticker}_{exchange_ts}_{payload_hash[:12]}.

fifteen_institutional_causal_rules.name: Exchange-Effective Timestamp
fifteen_institutional_causal_rules.specification: Every event explicitly declares the exchange date/time when market transactions occurred (exchange_ts).

fifteen_institutional_causal_rules.name: Ingestion / Received Timestamp
fifteen_institutional_causal_rules.specification: Every event records the wall-clock received timestamp (received_ts) to measure latency and out-of-order arrival.

fifteen_institutional_causal_rules.name: Deterministic Event Processing
fifteen_institutional_causal_rules.specification: Events processed in the same order yield identical internal state transitions and portfolio valuations without non-deterministic side effects.

fifteen_institutional_causal_rules.name: Append-Only Event Journaling
fifteen_institutional_causal_rules.specification: Inbound accepted events are appended to an immutable JSONL log. Existing log records are never modified, rewritten, or truncated in place.

fifteen_institutional_causal_rules.name: Idempotent Event Deduplication
fifteen_institutional_causal_rules.specification: Resubmission of an already accepted event (matching event_id and payload_hash) returns DUPLICATE_IDEMPOTENT with zero mutation of portfolio state.

fifteen_institutional_causal_rules.name: Conflicting Payload Quarantine
fifteen_institutional_causal_rules.specification: Submission of an event with an existing event_id but mismatched payload_hash is immediately quarantined as QUARANTINED_CONFLICT without modifying accepted state.

fifteen_institutional_causal_rules.name: Committed Watermark Protection
fifteen_institutional_causal_rules.specification: The engine maintains a strictly monotonic committed_watermark_date. Late market observations with exchange_ts <= committed_watermark_date cannot rewrite past decisions or trigger retroactive trades.

fifteen_institutional_causal_rules.name: Watermark Buffering and Late Quarantine
fifteen_institutional_causal_rules.specification: Events with exchange_ts > watermark are buffered until the watermark advances; events with exchange_ts <= watermark are quarantined with reason ARRIVED_POST_WATERMARK_COMMITMENT.

fifteen_institutional_causal_rules.name: Explicit Revision Records
fifteen_institutional_causal_rules.specification: Exchange or data provider restatements generate explicit REVISION events pointing to parent_event_id. Revisions are recorded for auditability but cannot execute retroactive fills.

fifteen_institutional_causal_rules.name: Decision Provenance Tracking
fifteen_institutional_causal_rules.specification: Every decision and fill explicitly records input_event_ids and market payload hashes present at the exact moment of execution.

fifteen_institutional_causal_rules.name: Immutable Fill Ledger
fifteen_institutional_causal_rules.specification: Simulated and confirmed fills are stored as frozen, immutable records (ImmutableFill) with permanent execution prices, slippage, and PnL.

fifteen_institutional_causal_rules.name: Anti-Retroactive Execution Barrier
fifteen_institutional_causal_rules.specification: No late event, revision, or restatement can retroactively execute orders against past market days.

fifteen_institutional_causal_rules.name: Deterministic Crash Recovery
fifteen_institutional_causal_rules.specification: Engine state can be fully reconstructed from any verified cryptographic snapshot combined with sequential replay of the append-only journal.

fifteen_institutional_causal_rules.name: Zero Silent History Sorting
fifteen_institutional_causal_rules.specification: Chronological sorting is strictly confined to uncommitted buffers before decision generation. Once a day is committed, the historical sequence is locked.
